entries.definition: A paratha is a flatbread that originated in the Indian subcontinent, prevalent throughout areas of India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nepal and Bangladesh where wheat is the traditional staple.

entries.label: lamb neck
entries.definition: A whole neck that is obtained from a lamb.

entries.label: blood food product
entries.definition: A blood food product is a food product made primarily from blood, the most important byproduct of slaughtering.

entries.label: akutaq
entries.definition: A food in western Alaska and northern Canada, traditionally made with whipped fat mixed with berries like cranberries, salmonberries, crowberries, cloudberries and blueberries, fish, tundra greens, or roots with animal oil or fat. It may also include whitefish, caribou tallow, moose tallow, walrus tallow, or seal oil.

entries.label: juniper ash
entries.definition: Juniper ash is ash derived from the juniper tree.

entries.label: Williams pear (raw)
entries.definition: The most commonly grown variety of pear fruit in most countries outside Asia.

entries.label: bolillo
entries.definition: A bolillo is a type of savory bread traditionally made in Mexico, but also made in Central America. It is a variation of the baguette, but shorter in length and is often baked in a stone oven.

entries.label: corn nut
entries.definition: Corn nuts are a snack food made of roasted or deep-fried corn kernels. In parts of South America, including Peru and Ecuador, it is referred to as cancha.

entries.label: cream soda
entries.definition: Cream soda is a sweet soft drink. Generally flavored with vanilla and based on the taste of an ice cream soda, a wide range of variations can be found worldwide.

entries.label: demerara sugar
entries.definition: Demerara sugar is a sugar made from crystallized, partially evaporated sugar cane juice and spun in a centrifuge to remove almost all of the molasses. The sugar crystals are large and golden-coloured.

entries.label: enchilada
entries.definition: An enchilada is a corn tortilla rolled around a filling and covered with a chili pepper sauce. Enchiladas can be filled with a variety of ingredients, including various meats, cheese, beans, potatoes, vegetables or combinations.

entries.label: fried rice
entries.definition: Fried rice is a dish of cooked rice that has been stir-fried in a wok or a frying pan and is usually mixed with other ingredients such as eggs, vegetables, seafood, or meat.

entries.label: frybread
entries.definition: Frybread is a flat dough bread, fried or deep-fried in oil, shortening, or lard.

entries.label: fully hydrogenated oil
entries.definition: Fully hydrogenated fat is hydrogenated oil in which all carbon-carbon bonds get changed to hydrogen-carbon and no “trans” molecules remain.

entries.label: Granny Smith apple
entries.definition: A pome fruit of a Granny Smith apple tree cultivar.

entries.label: hydrogenated oil
entries.definition: Hydrogenated oil is oil in which some or all molecular carbon-carbon bonds are reduced as a result of some hydrogenation process.

entries.label: Hohoysi tea
entries.definition: Hohoysi tea is tea derived from the leaves of the Thelesperma megapotamicum plant.

entries.label: partly hydrogenated oil
entries.definition: Partly hydrogenated oil is hydrogenated oil in which most carbon-carbon bonds get changed to hydrogen-carbon.

entries.label: Irish soda bread
entries.definition: Irish soda bread is soda bread made with soft wheat.

entries.label: Fuji apple
entries.definition: A pome fruit of a Fuji apple tree cultivar.

entries.label: Blaufränkisch wine
entries.definition: A red wine varietal produced entirely from Blaufränkisch grapes.

entries.label: mashu root
entries.definition: A Mashu root is the edible root of the pea (Hedysarum alpinums), native to alaska. It is usually collected in quantity from river banks and gravel bars.

entries.label: Medjool date
entries.definition: A Medjool date is a large, sweet cultivated variety of date (Phoenix dactylifera) from Morocco, also grown in the United States, Israel, Iran, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Jordan and Palestine.

entries.label: mexican rice (dish)
entries.definition: Spanish rice is a Mexican side dish or an ingredient in other dishes made from white rice, tomatoes, garlic, onions, etc. It is traditionally made by sautéing the rice in a skillet with oil or fat until it is colored golden brown. Water or chicken broth is then added, along with tomatoes in the form of chopped tomatoes or tomato sauce.

entries.label: nattō
entries.definition: Nattō is a traditional Japanese food made from soybeans that have been fermented with Bacillus subtilis var. natto.  Some eat it as a breakfast food.

entries.label: oheloberry
entries.definition: The oheloberry is an edible berry 8–14 mm (0.31–0.55 in) diameter, ranging in color from blue to purple to red to orange to yellow, harvested from the oheloberry plant.

entries.label: okara
entries.definition: Okara, soy pulp, or tofu dregs is a pulp consisting of insoluble parts of the soybean that remains after pureed soybeans are filtered in the production of soy milk and tofu

entries.label: picnic loaf
entries.definition: A picnic loaf is a bread loaf, hollowed out somewhat and stuffed with sandwich ingredients, and then sliced into serving-sized wedges.

entries.label: jiaozi
entries.definition: Jiaozi are a kind of Chinese dumpling, commonly eaten in China and other parts of East Asia.  Jiaozi typically consist of a ground meat and/or vegetable filling wrapped into a thinly rolled piece of dough, which is then sealed by pressing the edges together.

entries.label: pumpkin pie spice
entries.definition: Pumpkin pie spice, also known as pumpkin spice, is an American spice mix commonly used as an ingredient in pumpkin pie. Pumpkin pie spice is similar to the British and Commonwealth mixed spice. It is generally a blend of ground cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, and sometimes allspice.

entries.label: sofrito
entries.definition: Sofrito is a sauce used as a base in Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Latin American cooking. Preparations may vary, but it typically consists of aromatic ingredients cut into small pieces and sauteed or braised in cooking oil.

entries.label: Sōmen
entries.definition: Sōmen are very thin noodles made of wheat flour, less than 1.3 mm in diameter.

entries.label: somiviki
entries.definition: Somiviki is a small, tamale-shaped sweet blue corn cake made with Hopi blue corn, juniper ashes, sugar and boiling water.

entries.label: scrapple
entries.definition: Scrapple, also known by the Pennsylvania Dutch name Pannhaas or "pan rabbit", is traditionally a mush of pork scraps and trimmings combined with cornmeal and wheat flour, often buckwheat flour, and spices. The mush is formed into a semi-solid congealed loaf, and slices of the scrapple are then pan-fried before serving.

entries.label: short grain rice kernel
entries.definition: A rice grain which is is shorter in length proportional to its width than that of long grain rice.

entries.label: beef short rib
entries.definition: A beef cut that is derived from the 6th, 7th and 8th rib of the rib primal.

entries.label: fermented salmon
entries.definition: Fermented salmon is salmon subjected to a fermentation process.

entries.label: tea seed oil
entries.definition: Tea seed oil is an edible plant oil. It is obtained the seeds of Camellia oleifera. Camellia sasanqua is also given as a source of 'tea seed oil.

entries.label: blue crabmeat
entries.definition: Blue crabmeat is crab meat derived from a blue crab, Callinectes sapidus.

entries.label: yellow bean pod
entries.definition: A yellow bean pod is a bean pod obtained from a yellow bean plant.

entries.label: black turtle bean
entries.definition: A  small, shiny variety of a common bean plant (Phaseolus vulgaris).

entries.label: meringue (dish)
entries.definition: Meringue is a type of dessert or candy, often associated with Italian, Swiss, and French cuisine, traditionally made from whipped egg whites and sugar, and occasionally an acidic ingredient such as lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar.

entries.label: rock lobster tail
entries.definition: The tail of a rock lobster which may or may not be shelled.

entries.label: calamari
entries.definition: Calamari in english names a variety of dishes made of fried, deep fried or baked squid.

entries.label: king crabmeat
entries.definition: King crabmeat is meat that is removed from the leg of a King Crab.

entries.label: Masago
entries.definition: Masago is a dish consisting of the fully ripened eggs (roe) of the capelin fish.

entries.label: wild harvested animal
entries.definition: An organism that originated from a wild (non-domesticated) population.

entries.label: bratwurst
entries.definition: Bratwurst is a type of German sausage made from veal, beef, or most commonly pork.

entries.label: mutton
entries.definition: The meat of an adult sheep is mutton, a term only used for the meat, not the living animals.

entries.label: gambier powder
entries.definition: Gambier or gambir is an extract derived from the leaves of Uncaria gambir, a climbing shrub native to tropical Southeast Asia. Gambier is produced in Indonesia and Malaysia where it was an important trade item into the late nineteenth century. It can be used as a tanning agent, a brown dye, a food additive and as herbal medicine. Also known as pale catechu, white catechu or Japan Earth, it is ofte

entries.label: bhuna chana
entries.definition: Bhuna chana (roasted black gram) are roasted chickpeas eaten as a snack. Common in India.

entries.label: grana padano
entries.definition: Grana Padano is a cheese originated from Po River Valley in northern Italy that has similar characteristics as Parmigiano Reggiano or known as Parmesan cheese, but with less regulations.

entries.label: green cabbage head
entries.definition: A rosette of a green cabbage plant cultivar.

entries.label: red cabbage head
entries.definition: The red cabbage (purple-leaved varieties of Brassica oleracea Capitata Group) is a kind of cabbage, also known as purple cabbage, red kraut, or blue kraut after preparation. Its leaves are coloured dark red/purple.

entries.label: green cardamom pod
entries.definition: A pod harvested from a green cardamom plant variety.

entries.label: black cardamom pod
entries.definition: A pod harvested from a black cardamom plant variety.

entries.label: mole verde
entries.definition: Mole verde ("green mole") is a type of mole of the cuisine of Mexico. The main ingredients are pumpkin seeds and green chile, which bring color.

entries.label: green mole powder
entries.definition: Dehydrated mole verde (green mole sauce).

entries.label: heirloom tomato (raw)
entries.definition: An heirloom tomato is an open-pollinated (non-hybrid) heirloom cultivar of tomato, that can be classified into four categories: family heirlooms, commercial heirlooms, mystery heirlooms, and created heirlooms. They usually have a shorter shelf life and less disease resistance than hybrids bred to resist against specific diseases.

entries.label: ground chuck
entries.definition: Chuck is a type of beef cut from the shoulder of a cow. Ground chuck is ground shoulder meat.

entries.label: ground round
entries.definition: Ground round is ground leg meat. Round cuts of beef come from the hind leg of a cow.

entries.label: halva
entries.definition: Halva is any of various dense, sweet confections made in the Middle East, Central and South Asia.

entries.label: hazelnut food product
entries.definition: A hazelnut food product is a food product that derives from hazelnuts

entries.label: hazelnut
entries.definition: The hazelnut is the nut of the hazel and therefore includes any of the nuts deriving from species of the genus Corylus, especially the nuts of the species Corylus avellana. It also is known as cobnut or filbert nut according to species.

entries.label: venison
entries.definition: Venison originally meant the meat of a game animal, and now especially means a deer or antelope (in South Africa). Venison can be used to refer to any part of the animal, so long as it can be consumed, including the internal organs. Venison, much like beef or pork, is categorized into specific cuts, including roast, sirloin, and ribs.

entries.label: asafoetida
entries.definition: Asafoetida is the dried latex (gum oleoresin) (Perumkayam) exuded from the rhizome or tap root of several species of Ferula (F. foetida and F. assa-foetida), perennial herbs growing 1 to 1.5 m (3.3 to 4.9 ft) tall. They are part of the celery family, Umbelliferae. The species are native to the deserts of Iran and mountains of Afghanistan, but are mainly cultivated in nearby Pakistan and India. Asa

entries.label: soursop
entries.definition: An aggregate fruit of a soursop plant (Annona muricata)

entries.label: horchata
entries.definition: Horchata or orxata, is a name given to various plant milk beverages of similar taste and appearance.

entries.label: horn and hoof meal
entries.definition: Horn and hoof meal is a type of animal feed made from the horns and hooves of animals, particularly ruminants.

entries.label: instant noodle
entries.definition: Instant noodles are a noodle dish sold in a precooked and dried noodle block, with flavoring powder and/or seasoning oil. The flavoring is usually in a separate packet, although in the case of cup noodles the flavoring is often loose in the cup.  Originally a Japanese product, instant noodles are now produced in many other markets.

entries.label: flatbread wrap
entries.definition: A wrap is a food dish made with a soft flatbread rolled around a filling. It is usually but not always classified as a sandwich.

entries.label: parsley leaf
entries.definition: A leaf of a parsley plant (Petroselinum crispum)

entries.label: kelp meal
entries.definition: Kelp meal is natural fertilizer and animal feed supplement made from dried seaweed (Ascophyllum nodosom).

entries.label: kibble
entries.definition: Kibble is small, dry pellets of processed food for pets (such as dogs and cats)

entries.label: kimchi
entries.definition: Kimchi, a staple in Korean cuisine, is a famous traditional side dish of salted and fermented vegetables, such as napa cabbage and Korean radish, made with a widely varying selection of seasonings including gochugaru (chili powder), scallions, garlic, ginger, and jeotgal (salted seafood), etc. There are hundreds of varieties of kimchi made with different vegetables as the main ingredients.

entries.label: andouille sausage
entries.definition: Andouille is a smoked sausage made using pork, originating in France.

entries.label: kohlrabi leaf
entries.definition: A kohlrabi leaf is a leaf harvested from a kohlrabi plant.

entries.label: kohlrabi food product
entries.definition: A kohlrabi food product is a food product derived from the stem (bulbous part) and/or leaf of the kohlrabi plant.

entries.label: patty
entries.definition: A patty, in American, Canadian, South African, Australian and New Zealand English, is a flattened, usually round, serving of ground food, often meat or meat alternatives. The food is compacted and shaped into the patty, then cooked, and served.

entries.label: leftover
entries.definition: The uneaten edible remains of a meal after food consumption has ended, which does not include material that is not directly edible (such as bones or the skins of some vegetables and fruits).

entries.label: chow mein
entries.definition: Chow mein is a dish containing Chinese stir-fried noodles with vegetables and sometimes meat or tofu; the name is a romanization of the Taishanese chāu-mèing.

entries.label: beef prime rib roast
entries.definition: A cut of beef from the primal rib, one of the nine primal cuts of beef. While the entire rib section comprises ribs six through 12, a standing rib roast may contain anywhere from two to seven ribs.

entries.label: game meat
entries.definition: Bushmeat, wildmeat, or game meat is meat from non-domesticated mammals, reptiles, amphibians and birds hunted for food in tropical forests.

entries.label: lemongrass leaf
entries.definition: A whole leaf of a lemongrass plant (Cymbopogon citratus).

entries.label: beef sausage
entries.definition: Beef sausage is sausage primarily made of beef.

entries.label: macaroni and cheese
entries.definition: Macaroni and cheese is a dish of English origin, consisting of cooked macaroni pasta and a cheese sauce, most commonly cheddar. It can also incorporate other ingredients, such as breadcrumbs, meat and vegetables.

entries.label: chia seed
entries.definition: A seed of a chia plant (Salvia hispanica).

entries.label: safflower flower
entries.definition: Safflower flowers come from the plant Carthamus tinctorius, and are occasionally used in cooking as a cheaper substitute for saffron, sometimes referred to as "bastard saffron". The dried safflower petals are also used as a herbal tea variety.

entries.label: Kapchunka fish
entries.definition: Kapchunka is an ungutted, dried, salted whitefish product of Russian ethnic origin.

entries.label: okazi leaf
entries.definition: A leaf of an okazi plant (Gnetum africanum).

entries.label: okazi tuber
entries.definition: A tuber of an okazi plant (Gnetum africanum).

entries.label: eru soup
entries.definition: Eru is a soup from Cameroon made from okazi leaves. It is vegetable soup made up of finely shredded and stewed leaves, waterleaf or spinach (okazi leaves), palm oil, and either smoked fish, cow skin (kanda) or beef.

entries.label: food (precooked)
entries.definition: Food material which has been prepared and cooked in advance so that it only needs to be heated quickly (if at all) before consumption.

entries.label: Tango apple
entries.definition: An apple harvested from a Tango apple tree cultivar.

entries.label: thalipeeth bhajani
entries.definition: Thalipeeth bhajani is multigrain flour mix made of roasted grains and pulses and flavoured with coriander and cumin, and is used to make thalipeeth savoury pancakes.

entries.label: thalipeeth
entries.definition: Thalipeeth is a popular Maharashtrian Breakfast Pancake or thick flatbread that resembles a thick paratha but made with a variety of flours that are gluten free and millet based.

entries.label: food (powdered)
entries.definition: Ground food material which has a powdered characteristic.

entries.label: baby spinach
entries.definition: Baby spinach is spinach that has been harvested during a fairly early stage of plant growth, usually between 15-35 days after planting.

entries.label: vegetable patty
entries.definition: A vegetable patty is a patty made with vegetables and without animal ingredients.

entries.label: butternut squash (raw)
entries.definition: A squash harvested from the butternut squash plant.

entries.label: tataki
entries.definition: Tataki (Japanese たたき: "pounded" or "hit into pieces") is a method of preparing fish or meat in Japanese cuisine.

entries.label: tuna tataki
entries.definition: A tataki made primarily with tuna.

entries.label: fish steak
entries.definition: A fish steak, alternatively known as a fish cutlet, is a cut of fish which is cut perpendicular to the spine and can either include the bones or be boneless.

entries.label: tuna steak
entries.definition: A tuna steak is a cut of fish from a tuna.

entries.label: broccoli sprout
entries.definition: A shoot of a germinated broccoli seed.

entries.label: food (julienned)
entries.definition: Food material - usually a vegetable - which is cut into long thin strips, similar to matchsticks.

entries.label: baklava
entries.definition: Baklava is a rich, sweet dessert pastry made of layers of filo filled with chopped nuts and sweetened and held together with syrup or honey.

entries.label: fresh bratwurst
entries.definition: Fresh bratwurst is bratwurst sausage that has not been subject to cooking.

entries.label: cooked bratwurst
entries.definition: Cooked bratwurst is bratwurst sausage that has been cooked.

entries.label: ancho pepper
entries.definition: The poblano (Capsicum annuum) is a mild chili pepper originating in the state of Puebla, Mexico. Dried, it is called ancho or chile ancho, from the Spanish word ancho ("wide").

entries.label: ancho powder
entries.definition: Ancho Powder is a type of chile powder, specifically ground ancho (poblano) chile peppers.

entries.label: ivy gourd food product
entries.definition: A food product made from an ivy gourd plant species.

entries.label: Verhackert
entries.definition: Verhackert is a spread of minced bacon, combined with garlic and salt. A traditional dish, the preparation of bacon takes place over two months, which includes freezing the meat two to three times. Once the meat is ready, it is minced with the other ingredients and pressed into a terrine. Verhackert is served cold with bread as an appetizer.

entries.label: flatbread
entries.definition: A flatbread is a bread made with flour, water, and salt, and then thoroughly rolled into flattened dough. Many flatbreads are unleavened, although some are slightly leavened, such as pita bread.

entries.label: macadamia nut
entries.definition: A seed of a macadamia nut tree (Macadamia integrifolia).

entries.label: pickled cucumber
entries.definition: A pickled cucumber (commonly known as a pickle in the United States and Canada and a gherkin in Britain, Ireland, Australia, South Africa and New Zealand) is a cucumber that has been pickled in a brine, vinegar, or other solution and left to ferment for a period of time, by either immersing the cucumbers in an acidic solution or through souring by lacto-fermentation.

entries.label: saskatoon berry
entries.definition: A saskatoon berry derives from the or saskatoon plant.

entries.label: Nankin cherry (raw)
entries.definition: A Nankin cherry is a cherry harvested from the Nankin cherry tree.

entries.label: wax bean
entries.definition: A seed of a wax bean plant having a yellow or white colored pod, a varietal of a common bean plant (phaseolus vulgaris).

entries.label: bell pepper food product
entries.definition: A bell pepper is a fruits in different colours - including red, yellow, orange, green, white, and purple - from a bell pepper plant cultivar.  Bell peppers are sometimes grouped with less pungent pepper varieties as "sweet peppers".

entries.label: golden zucchini squash
entries.definition: A golden or yellow zucchini is a summer squash harvested from the golden zucchini cultivar.

entries.label: pattypan squash (raw)
entries.definition: Sunburst squash is a summer squash (species *Cucurbita pepo*) notable for its small size, round and shallow shape, and scalloped edges, somewhat resembling a small toy top, or flying saucer.

entries.label: cheese soup
entries.definition: Cheese soup is a type of soup prepared using cheese as a primary ingredient, along with milk, broth and/or stock to form its basis.

entries.label: shallot (raw)
entries.definition: A shallot is the bulb part of a shallot plant

entries.label: black olive
entries.definition: A fully mature black/purple/brown colored drupe fruit of an olive tree (Olea europaea).

entries.label: drupelet berry food product
entries.definition: A drupelet berry food product is a product made from aggregated drupelet "berries" such as Raspberries and Blackberries.

entries.label: pomelo fruit
entries.definition: A whole fruit of a pomelo tree (Citrus maximus)

entries.label: savoy cabbage head (raw)
entries.definition: A cabbage head from a Savoy cabbage plant.

entries.label: bullocks heart (raw)
entries.definition: A raw bullock's heart

entries.label: cherimoya fruit (raw)
entries.definition: A whole cherimoya fruit which is raw.

entries.label: greater burdock root
entries.definition: Greater burdock root is a root harvested from the greater burdock plant.

entries.label: tarragon leaf (fresh)
entries.definition: Tarragon leaf is a leaf from a tarragon plant

entries.label: mugwort leaves and buds
entries.definition: Mugwort leaves and buds, best picked shortly before mugwort flowers in July to September, can be used as a bitter flavoring agent to season fat, meat and fish. Mugwort has also been used to flavor beer before the introduction of hops

entries.label: pear
entries.definition: A pome fruit of a pear tree.

entries.label: herb food product
entries.definition: A leaf of a plant that is used for flavoring.

entries.label: basil food product
entries.definition: A food product that has some defining ingredient some basil part.

entries.label: softneck garlic
entries.definition: Softneck garlic is garlic from the (Allium sativum ssp. sativum) plant, and is widely available in grocery stores.

entries.label: hardneck garlic
entries.definition: Hardneck garlic is garlic from the Allium sativum ssp. ophioscorodon garlic plant, and is closer to wild garlic, with complex flavors.

entries.label: hummus
entries.definition: Hummus is a Levantine dip or spread made from cooked, mashed chickpeas or other beans, blended with tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and garlic.

entries.label: empanada
entries.definition: A type of baked or fried turnover consisting of pastry and filling, common in Southern European, Latin American, Indonesian, and the Philippines cultures.

entries.label: arepa (dish)
entries.definition: A type of food made of ground maize dough, originating from the northern region of South America in pre-Columbian times, and is notable in the cuisines of Colombia and Venezuela.

entries.label: pupusa (dish)
entries.definition: Pupusa is a thick flatbread from El Salvador made with cornmeal or rice flour, similar to the Venezuelan and Colombian arepa. It is usually stuffed with one or more ingredients.

entries.label: trail mix
entries.definition: Trail mix or scroggin is a caste of snack mix, specifically a combination of granola, dried fruit, nuts, and sometimes chocolate, developed as a food to be taken along on hikes.

entries.label: rice bread
entries.definition: Rice bread is a type of bread that is made from rice flour rather than wheat flour.

entries.label: Pan dulce
entries.definition: Pan dulce (English: sweet bread) is the name for a variety of Mexican pastries.

entries.label: grits
entries.definition: A dish made from boiled cornmeal.

entries.label: piki
entries.definition: Piki is a bread made from blue corn meal used in Hopi cuisine.

entries.label: pita bread
entries.definition: Pita is a family of yeast-leavened round flatbreads baked from wheat flour, common in the Mediterranean, Middle East, and neighboring areas.

entries.label: robusta coffee (liquid)
entries.definition: A coffee beverage made from robusta coffee beans, which tend to be less acidic, more bitter, and have more caffeine than arabica beans.

entries.label: arabica coffee (liquid)
entries.definition: A coffee beverage made from arabica coffee beans

entries.label: arrowroot starch
entries.definition: A starch obtained from the rhizomes (rootstock) of several tropical plants, traditionally Maranta arundinacea, but also Florida arrowroot from Zamia integrifolia, and tapioca from cassava (Manihot esculenta), which is often labelled as arrowroot.

entries.label: arrowroot (raw)
entries.definition: Arrowroot is an edible tuber from the arrowroot plant that was extensively used by the Indigenous peoples of the Americas.

entries.label: sacred pear (raw)
entries.definition: The sacred pear is a pear of the Crateva religiosa tree.

entries.label: pineapple sage leaf
entries.definition: A whole leaf from a pineapple sage plant.

entries.label: black radish (raw)
entries.definition: A black radish is a radish of the black radish plant

entries.label: daikon (raw)
entries.definition: A daikon radish is a radish of the daikon radish plant

entries.label: red rice kernel
entries.definition: A whole grain rice kernel which has a red coloration due to its bran anthocyanin content.

entries.label: prickly pear pad
entries.definition: A pad of a prickly pear cactus (Opuntia ficus-indica)

entries.label: chinese yam
entries.definition: Chinese yam is a tuber of the Dioscorea polystachya plant

entries.label: mountain yam
entries.definition: Mountain yam is a tuber of the Dioscorea japonica  plant.

entries.label: veal
entries.definition: A whole veal.

entries.label: japanese chestnut (raw)
entries.definition: A Japanese chestnut is a chestnut from a japanese chestnut tree.

entries.label: young jackfruit
entries.definition: A young jackfruit is an immature fruit; it has a mild taste and meat-like texture that lends itself to being a meat substitute for vegetarians and vegans.

entries.label: jackfruit (raw)
entries.definition: A whole jackfruit is a fruit of the jackfruit tree (Artocarpus heterophyllus).

entries.label: ginkgo nut (raw)
entries.definition: A raw ginkgo nut

entries.label: lychee
entries.definition: A drupe fruit of a lychee tree (Litchi chinensis) .

entries.label: star fruit
entries.definition: A berry fruit from a star fruit plant (Averrhoa carambola)

entries.label: barley seed (raw)
entries.definition: Barley is a cultivated grain used as animal fodder, as a source of fermentable material for beer and certain distilled beverages, and as a component of various health foods. It is used in soups and stews, and in barley bread of various cultures. Barley grains are commonly made into malt in a traditional and ancient method of preparation.

entries.label: hyssop food product
entries.definition: A hyssop food product is a product made with the leaves, flowers, or oil extract of the hyssop plant.

entries.label: mangosteen food product
entries.definition: A mangosteen food product is a food product made from the mangosteen tree.

entries.label: mammea africana fruit product
entries.definition: Mammee apple, mamey apple or mammey apple

entries.label: mamey apple
entries.definition: A berry from the Mamey apple tree (Mammea americana)

entries.label: lotus plant food product
entries.definition: A lotus plant food product is a seed, pip, rhizome, leaf or flower product obtained from the lotus plant.

entries.label: Colorado pinyon pine nut food product

aliases.text: Colorado pinyon pine nut food product
aliases.norm: colorado pinyon pine nut food product

entries.definition: A pine nut food product made from Colorado pinyon nuts.

entries.label: surinam cherry
entries.definition: A berry fruit of a surinam cherry plant.

entries.label: salmonberry (raw)
entries.definition: A whole raw salmonberry is a berry harvested from the salmonberry plant.

entries.label: durian (raw)
entries.definition: A durian is the fruit of several tree species belonging to the genus Durio.

entries.label: squashberry (raw)
entries.definition: A squashberry is a berry from the squashberry plant.

entries.label: catjang pea (raw)
entries.definition: A raw catjang pea.

entries.label: gai lan
entries.definition: Gai lan is the leaf and stem component of the gai lan plant

entries.label: common wheat kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a common wheat plant (Triticum aestivum).

entries.label: mulberry (raw)
entries.definition: A mulberry is a fruit multiple from a mulberry plant

entries.label: bayberry (raw)
entries.definition: Bayberry is a sweet, crimson to dark purple-red, fruit from the Myrica rubra tree.

entries.label: dulce de leche
entries.definition: Dulce de leche is a confection from Latin America prepared by slowly heating sweetened milk to create a substance that derives its flavour from the Maillard reaction, also changing colour, with an appearance and flavour similar to caramel.

entries.label: stew
entries.definition: A stew is a combination of solid food ingredients that have been cooked in liquid and served in the resultant gravy.

entries.label: heart of palm
entries.definition: An inner core and growing bud of certain palm trees, including coconut, acai palm, sabal, and juçara

entries.label: junket (dish)
entries.definition: Junket is a milk-based dessert, made with sweetened milk and rennet, the digestive enzyme that curdles milk.

entries.label: bulgur
entries.definition: Bulgur is a cereal food made from the cracked parboiled groats of several different wheat species, most often from durum wheat.

entries.label: caffè mocha
entries.definition: A caffè mocha is a chocolate-flavored variant of a caffè latte

entries.label: chimichanga
entries.definition: Chimichanga is a deep-fried burrito that is common in Tex-Mex and other Southwestern U.S. cuisine.

entries.label: tapioca pearls
entries.definition: Tapioca pearls are pebble-sized spheres of tapioca; sizes range from about 1 mm to 8 mm in diameter, with 2–3 mm being the most common.

entries.label: nutritional drink
entries.definition: Nutrition drinks are beverages that promise a healthy balance of protein, carbohydrate, and fat.

entries.label: Canadian bacon
entries.definition: The American name for a form of back bacon that is cured, smoked and fully cooked, trimmed into cylindrical medallions, and thickly sliced. "Canadian" bacon is made only from the lean eye of the loin and is ready to eat. Its flavor is described as more ham-like than other types because of its lean cut.

entries.label: back bacon
entries.definition: Back bacon is a cut of bacon that includes the pork loin from the back of the pig. It may also include a portion of the pork belly in the same cut. It is much leaner than side bacon made only from the pork belly.

entries.label: heart food product
entries.definition: A heart meat product is a food product deriving from heart organ(s).

entries.label: brain food product
entries.definition: A brain food product is a food product deriving from animal brain.

entries.label: spelt kernel
entries.definition: A whole kernel of spelt (Triticum spelta)

entries.label: sweetbread food product
entries.definition: Sweetbread is a culinary name for the thymus (also called throat, gullet, or neck sweetbread) or pancreas (also called stomach, belly or gut sweetbread), typically from calf (ris de veau) and lamb (ris d'agneau), and, less commonly, beef and pork.

entries.label: almond milk
entries.definition: Almond milk is a plant milk manufactured from almonds with a creamy texture and nutty flavor,

entries.label: poultry sandwich
entries.definition: A poultry sandwich contains chicken, turkey or other poultry meat.

entries.label: seafood sandwich
entries.definition: A seafood sandwich is a sandwich made with fish and/or other seafood ingredients.

entries.label: scarlet runner bean food product
entries.definition: A bean food product harvested frrom the scarlet runner bean plant.

entries.label: scarlet runner bean pod
entries.definition: A bean pod harvested frrom the scarlet runner bean plant.

entries.label: longan (raw)
entries.definition: A fruit of the longan tree (Dimocarpus longan).

entries.label: rambutan (raw)
entries.definition: A fruit of the Rambutan tree.

entries.label: welsh onion
entries.definition: An onion that is harvested from the Welsh onion plant.

entries.label: nut (raw, shell on)
entries.definition: A whole raw nut with its shell intact.

entries.label: vegetarian burger
entries.definition: A burger patty that does not contain meat or any such kind of meat. These burgers may be made from ingredients like beans, especially soybeans and tofu, nuts, grains, seeds or fungi such as mushrooms or mycoprotein.

entries.label: guarana food product
entries.definition: A food product from the seed of guarana plants.

entries.label: longan fruit food product
entries.definition: A food product derived from fruit of the longan tree (Dimocarpus longan).

entries.label: jojoba bean food product
entries.definition: A food product derived from jojoba beans.

entries.label: Ymer
entries.definition: Ymer is a Danish soured milk product which has been known since 1930 and is made by fermenting whole milk with the bacterial culture Lactococcus lactis.

entries.label: crispbread
entries.definition: Crispbread is a flat and dry type of cracker, containing mostly rye flour.

entries.label: leavening agent
entries.definition: A leavening agent is any one of a number of substances used in doughs and batters that cause a foaming action (gas bubbles) that lightens and softens the mixture.

entries.label: chocolate spread
entries.definition: A sweet chocolate-flavored paste which is eaten mostly spread on breads and toasts or similar grain items such as waffles, pancakes, muffins, and pitas.

entries.label: wine gum
entries.definition: A chewy, firm pastille-type sweet similar to a gumdrop without the sugar coating, originating from the United Kingdom.

entries.label: energy drink
entries.definition: A type of drink containing sugar and stimulant compounds, usually caffeine, which is marketed as providing mental and physical stimulation (marketed as "energy", but distinct from food energy). They may or may not be carbonated and may also contain other sweeteners, herbal extracts, taurine, and amino acids.

entries.label: adobo
entries.definition: The immersion of raw food in a stock (or sauce) composed variously of paprika, oregano, salt, garlic, and vinegar to preserve and enhance its flavor.

entries.label: horned melon (raw)
entries.definition: A melon harvested from the horned melon plant.

entries.label: hushpuppy
entries.definition: A small, savory, deep-fried round ball made from cornmeal-based batter. Hushpuppies are frequently served as a side dish with seafood and other deep-fried foods.

entries.label: soy yogurt
entries.definition: A yogurt prepared with soy milk.

entries.label: vegetarian food material
entries.definition: A food product not including meat and animal tissue products (such as gelatin or animal-derived rennet).

entries.label: cupuaçu fruit (raw)
entries.definition: A cupuaçu fruit which is raw.

entries.label: shea fruit (raw)
entries.definition: A fruit of the shea tree.

entries.label: shea fruit food product
entries.definition: A food product derived from the fruit or seed of the shea tree.

entries.label: shea nut (raw)
entries.definition: The seed of a shea fruit.

entries.label: filo
entries.definition: A very thin unleavened dough used for making pastries such as baklava and börek in Middle Eastern and Balkan cuisines. Filo-based pastries are made by layering many sheets of filo brushed with oil or butter; the pastry is then baked.

entries.label: soy cream
entries.definition: Soybean material ground into a thick liquid, to which gums are added to create a substance resembling real cream found in mammalian milk.

entries.label: landjaeger
entries.definition: A semidried sausage traditionally made in Southern Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Alsace.

entries.label: beverage (liquid)
entries.definition: A liquid prepared for consumption

entries.label: peanut
entries.definition: A seed of a peanut plant (Arachis hypogaea).

entries.label: peanut pod (roasted)
entries.definition: A roasted peanut pod.

entries.label: miso
entries.definition: A traditional Japanese seasoning produced by fermenting soybeans with salt and kōji (the fungus Aspergillus oryzae) and sometimes rice, barley, seaweed or other ingredients.

entries.label: steel cut oats
entries.definition: Steel-cut oats (US) are groats (the inner kernel with the inedible hull removed) of whole oats which have been chopped into two or three pinhead-sized pieces (hence the names; "steel-cut" comes from the steel blades).

entries.label: soybean oil (low linolenic)
entries.definition: An oil made out of soybeans genetically modified to produce relatively low levels of linolenic acid in comparison to other soybeans.

entries.label: palm kernel oil (hydrogenated)
entries.definition: Palm kernel oil which has been partly or fully hydrogenated.

entries.label: confectionery fat
entries.definition: A fat used in the confectionery industry for making chocolate, candies, and baked goods. Confectionery fats must remain relatively stable during storage.

entries.label: coconut oil (hydrogenated)
entries.definition: Coconut oil which has been partly or completely hydrogenated.

entries.label: filling fat
entries.definition: A bakery filling containing a significant proportion of fat - usually 30% but ranging up to 60%.

entries.label: poppyseed oil
entries.definition: Poppyseed oil is an edible oil from poppy seeds (specifically seeds of Papaver somniferum, the opium poppy).

entries.label: tomato seed oil
entries.definition: A vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of tomatoes.

entries.label: walnut oil
entries.definition: Oil extracted from walnuts (from the Juglans regia tree).

entries.label: apricot kernel oil
entries.definition: Oil pressed from the kernels of the Prunus armeniaca (apricot). Apricot kernels have an oil content of 40-50%

entries.label: hazelnut oil
entries.definition: Oil pressed from hazelnuts. It is strongly flavoured and used as a cooking oil.

entries.label: cupuaçu fruit food product
entries.definition: A plant food product which derives from the cupuaçu plant.

entries.label: nutmeg butter
entries.definition: A butter obtained from the nutmeg nut by expression. It is semisolid, reddish-brown in colour, and has the taste and smell of nutmeg itself.

entries.label: ucuhuba seed oil
entries.definition: Oil extracted from the seed of ucuhuba plants (Virola surinamensis).

entries.label: soybean oil (partly hydrogenated)
entries.definition: A partly hydrogenated oil made from soybeans.

entries.label: rice bran oil
entries.definition: Oil extracted from the hard outer brown layer of rice called chaff (rice husk).

entries.label: soybean oil (fully hydrogenated)
entries.definition: A fully hydrogenated oil made from soybeans.

entries.label: plum tomato (raw)
entries.definition: A type of tomato bred for sauce and packing purposes.

entries.label: absinthe
entries.definition: A distilled, highly alcoholic beverage (45–74% ABV / 90–148 U.S. proof). It is an anise-flavoured spirit derived from botanicals, including the flowers and leaves of Artemisia absinthium ("grand wormwood"), together with green anise, sweet fennel, and other medicinal and culinary herbs.

entries.label: muesli
entries.definition: Muesli is a cold breakfast cereal dish based on rolled oats and ingredients like grains, nuts, seeds and fresh or dried fruits.

entries.label: tarte tropézienne
entries.definition: A dessert pastry consisting of a filled brioche.

entries.label: bolognese sauce
entries.definition: Bolognese sauce is a meat-based sauce in Italian cuisine, typical of the city of Bologna

entries.label: beef bourguignon
entries.definition: A beef stew braised in red wine, often red Burgundy, and beef stock, generally flavoured with carrots, onions, garlic, and a bouquet garni, and garnished with pearl onions, mushrooms, and bacon.

entries.label: brochette
entries.definition: Small skewer or spit on which small pieces of meat, fish or vegetables are roasted or broiled

entries.label: meat brochette
entries.definition: A small skewer of meat

entries.label: carbonara sauce
entries.definition: An Italian pasta sauce from Rome made with egg, hard cheese, guanciale (or pancetta), and black pepper.

entries.label: risotto
entries.definition: A northern Italian rice dish cooked with broth until it reaches a creamy consistency. The broth can be derived from meat, fish, or vegetables. Many types of risotto contain butter, onion, white wine, and parmesan cheese.

entries.label: ratatouille
entries.definition: A French Provençal stewed vegetable dish, originating in Nice, and sometimes referred to as ratatouille niçoise. Recipes and cooking times differ widely, but common ingredients include tomato, garlic, onion, zucchini, aubergine (eggplant), bell pepper, and some combination of leafy green herbs common to the region.

entries.label: tartiflette
entries.definition: A dish from Savoy in the Alps. It is made with potatoes, reblochon cheese, lardons and onions.

entries.label: tajine
entries.definition: A Maghrebi dish which is named after the earthenware pot in which it is cooked.

entries.label: tabbouleh
entries.definition: A Levantine vegetarian salad made mostly of finely chopped parsley, with tomatoes, mint, onion, bulgur (soaked, not cooked), and seasoned with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Some variations add garlic or lettuce, or use couscous instead of bulgur.

entries.label: sushi
entries.definition: A Japanese dish of prepared vinegared rice, usually with some sugar and salt, accompanying a variety of ingredients, such as seafood, vegetables, and occasionally tropical fruits.

entries.label: soufflé
entries.definition: A baked egg-based dish which originated in early eighteenth-century France. It is made with egg yolks and beaten egg whites combined with various other ingredients and served as a savory main dish or sweetened as a dessert.

entries.label: quenelle
entries.definition: A mixture of creamed fish or meat, sometimes combined with breadcrumbs, with a light egg binding, formed into an egg-like shape, and then cooked, usually by poaching.

entries.label: prosciutto
entries.definition: An Italian dry-cured ham that is usually thinly sliced and served uncooked.

entries.label: panini
entries.definition: A sandwich traditionally made with Italian bread (such as ciabatta, and michetta), usually served warmed by grilling or toasting.  In many English-speaking countries other types of bread such as baguettes may be used.

entries.label: pancetta
entries.definition: A salumi made of pork belly meat that is salt cured.

entries.label: paella
entries.definition: A Spanish rice dish originally from Valencia, named after the wide, shallow traditional pan used to cook the dish.

entries.label: omelette
entries.definition: A dish made from beaten eggs fried with butter or oil in a frying pan (without stirring as in scrambled egg). It is quite common for the omelette to be folded around fillings such as cheese, chives, vegetables, mushrooms, meat (often ham or bacon), or some combination of the above.

entries.label: moussaka
entries.definition: An eggplant- (aubergine) or potato-based dish, often including ground meat, in the Levant, Middle East, and Balkans, with many local and regional variations.

entries.label: mille-feuille pastry
entries.definition: A French pastry traditionally made up of three layers of puff pastry (pâte feuilletée), alternating with two layers of pastry cream (crème pâtissière). The top pastry layer is dusted with confectioner's sugar, and sometimes cocoa, pastry crumbs, or pulverized seeds (e.g. roasted almonds) or is glazed with icing or fondant in alternating white (icing) and brown (chocolate) stripes, and combed.

entries.label: mascarpone
entries.definition: An Italian cream cheese recognized as a Prodotto agroalimentare tradizionale (traditional regional food product), it is coagulated by the addition of certain acidic substances such as lemon juice, vinegar or citric acid.

entries.label: pale ale
entries.definition: A top-fermented beer made with predominantly pale malt.

entries.label: india pale ale
entries.definition: A hoppy beer style within the broader category of pale ale.

entries.label: strained yogurt
entries.definition: Yogurt that has been strained to remove most of its whey, resulting in a thicker consistency than unstrained yogurt, while preserving yogurt's distinctive sour taste. Like many types of yogurt, strained yogurt is often made from milk that has been enriched by boiling off some of its water content, or by adding extra butterfat and powdered milk. In Europe and North America, it is often made from lo

entries.label: Béchamel sauce
entries.definition: A sauce made from a white roux (butter and flour) and milk.

entries.label: chicken curry
entries.definition: A dish originating from the Indian subcontinent, consisting of chicken stewed in an onion- and tomato-based sauce, flavoured with curry powder and or ginger, garlic, tomato puree, chilli peppers, turmeric, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom etc.

entries.label: hachis parmentier
entries.definition: A dish of ground meat covered with mashed potatoes and baked, similar to the British dish shepherd's pie.

entries.label: shepherd's pie
entries.definition: A meat pie with a crust or topping of mashed potato.

entries.label: fondue savoyarde
entries.definition: A regional dish of Savoyard gastronomy based on processed cheese and bread. It is prepared from cheesaes such as the mountain county , Beaufort , Gruyère de Savoie , Emmental of Savoy.

entries.label: Burgundy fondue
entries.definition: A dish of beef dipped in fondue, originating in Switzerland.

entries.label: fat
entries.definition: Fat (in the strict sense) specifically refers to lipids that are solids at room temperature.

entries.label: fig
entries.definition: A fruit multiple of a fig plant (Ficus carica).

entries.label: flavouring additive
entries.definition: An additive used to modify flavour

entries.label: croziflette
entries.definition: A tartiflette except that small squares of pasta, crozets de Savoie (usually made from buckwheat but sometimes durum) are used instead of potatoes.

entries.label: croque monsieur
entries.definition: A baked or fried boiled ham and cheese sandwich.

entries.label: pork ribs
entries.definition: A cut of pork popular in Western and Asian cuisines. The ribcage of a domestic pig, meat and bones together, is cut into usable pieces, prepared by smoking, grilling, or baking – usually with a sauce, often barbecue – and then served.

entries.label: fajita
entries.definition: A Tex-Mex and Mexican cuisine dish usually served as a taco on a flour or corn tortilla, with toppings including cooked skirt steak or other cuts of beef, chicken, as well as vegetables instead of meat.  In restaurants, the meat is usually cooked with onions and bell peppers.

entries.label: cordon bleu (dish)
entries.definition: A dish of meat wrapped around cheese (or with cheese filling), then breaded and pan-fried or deep-fried.

entries.label: spätzle
entries.definition: A type of pasta made with fresh eggs and found in the cuisines of southern Germany and Austria, Switzerland, Hungary, Slovenia, Alsace, Moselle and South Tyrol.

entries.label: coffee (liquid, no cream or sugar)

aliases.norm: coffee liquid no cream or sugar

entries.definition: A prepared coffee beverage without cream or sugar.

entries.label: tiramisu
entries.definition: A coffee-flavoured Italian dessert made of ladyfingers (savoiardi) dipped in coffee, layered with a whipped mixture of eggs, sugar, and mascarpone cheese, flavoured with cocoa.

entries.label: red velvet cake
entries.definition: Red velvet cake is traditionally a red, red-brown, crimson or scarlet colored chocolate layer cake, layered with white cream cheese or ermine icing. Traditional recipes do not use food coloring, with the red color due to non-Dutched, anthocyanin-rich cocoa.

entries.label: rooibos tea (steeped)
entries.definition: Steeped tea made from dried Rooibos plant (Aspalathus linearis) tea leaves.

entries.label: raclette (dish)
entries.definition: A dish originating in Switzerland and prepared from raclette cheese round which is heated, either in front of a fire or by a special machine, then scraped onto diners' plates. It is accompanied by small firm potatoes, cornichons, pickled onions, and dried meat.

entries.label: Cornichon pickle
entries.definition: A tart French pickle made from a small gherkin pickled in vinegar and tarragon.

entries.label: soup (liquid)
entries.definition: A soup product in liquid form.

entries.label: citrus fruit zest
entries.definition: A food ingredient that is prepared by scraping or cutting from the outer, colorful skin of unwaxed citrus fruits such as lemon, orange, citron, and lime. Zest is used to add flavor to foods.

entries.label: truffle food product
entries.definition: A food product made from the fruiting body of a subterranean ascomycete fungus, predominantly one of the many species of the genus Tuber.

entries.label: peppercorn food product
entries.definition: A food product made from black, white, pink or similar peppercorns.

entries.label: tonka bean food product
entries.definition: A food product made from tonka beans

entries.label: tamarillo food product
entries.definition: A food product made from the tamarillo fruit.

entries.label: Manzanilla olive
entries.definition: A dual purpose medium to large drupe or stone fruit of the Olea europea tree used as table olives and for olive oil production

entries.label: white grapefruit juice
entries.definition: Juice from white grapefruit

entries.label: oatmeal raisin cookie
entries.definition: A type of drop cookie distinguished by an oatmeal-based dough with raisins mixed throughout.

entries.label: marinara sauce
entries.definition: A tomato sauce, usually made with tomatoes, garlic, herbs, and onions. Its many variations can include the addition of capers, olives, spices, and a dash of wine.

entries.label: sweet and sour dish
entries.definition: A dish flavoured with sweet and sour sauce, and having vegetables and/or animal meat.

entries.label: turkey sausage
entries.definition: A sausage made from turkey meat

entries.label: sunflower seed (shell off, roasted)
entries.definition: Roasted sunflower seeds with shell removed

entries.label: grape tomato (raw)
entries.definition: A class of tomatoes believed to be of southeast Asian origin, shaped similarly to the oval plum tomatoes but having the small size and sweetness of cherry tomatoes. Grape tomatoes produce small and typically oblong fruits.

entries.label: sweet and sour pork
entries.definition: A sweet and sour sauce dish having pork as a defining ingredient.

entries.label: blue corn flour
entries.definition: Flour ground from blue flint corn.

entries.label: winged bean pod
entries.definition: A pod from a winged bean plant.

entries.label: dog bone
entries.definition: A dog treat consisting of an animal bone with or without tendon or other tissue.

entries.label: rawhide
entries.definition: A dog chew made out of rawhide.

entries.label: pear tomato (raw)
entries.definition: A group of indeterminate heirloom tomatoes in the shape of a pear, but smaller, and having yellow, orange, and red varieties.

entries.label: white bean food product
entries.definition: A food product based on a group of beans distinguished by their white skin.

entries.label: graham flour
entries.definition: A type of coarse-ground whole wheat flour similar to conventional whole wheat flour in that both are made from the whole grain, but graham flour is ground more coarsely and is not sifted during milling (i.e. unbolted).

entries.label: langostino lobster product (sensu USA)
entries.definition: In the United States, a langostino lobster food product is legislated to refer to one of three species of squat lobster in the family Galatheidae: Cervimunida johni, Munida gregaria, and Pleuroncodes monodon.

entries.label: lemon (whole or pieces)
entries.definition: A lemon, whole or in pieces, for eating or other food processing.

entries.label: yuzu food product
entries.definition: A food product derived from yuzu fruit

entries.label: yuzu (raw)
entries.definition: A whole raw yuzu fruit

entries.label: citrus fruit
entries.definition: A hesperidium fruit of a citrus plant (Citrus).

entries.label: turkey thigh
entries.definition: A whole thigh that is obtained from a turkey.

entries.label: peanut butter sandwich
entries.definition: A sandwich containing peanut butter as a defining ingredient.

entries.label: turkey leg
entries.definition: A whole leg that is obtained from a turkey.

entries.label: turkey thigh (with skin)
entries.definition: A turkey thigh that contains skin.

entries.label: turkey thigh (skinless)
entries.definition: A skinless turkey thigh.

entries.label: chicken thigh (with skin)
entries.definition: A chicken thigh that contains skin.

entries.label: chicken thigh (skinless)
entries.definition: A skinless chicken thigh.

entries.label: lemongrass stalk
entries.definition: A stalk harvested from a lemon grass plant.

entries.label: brassica food product
entries.definition: A genus of plants in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). The members of the genus are informally known as cruciferous vegetables, cabbages, or mustard plants.

entries.label: Gala apple
entries.definition: A pome fruit of a Gala apple tree cultivar.

entries.label: white onion (raw)
entries.definition: A cultivar of dry onion, that has a pure white papery skin and a sweet, mild white flesh.

entries.label: sweet onion (raw)
entries.definition: A mild variety of onion having low sulfur content and high water content when compared to other onion varieties.

entries.label: brown rice flour
entries.definition: Rice flour made from brown rice and in which the bran and germ are included in the milling process.

entries.label: glutinous rice
entries.definition: A type of rice grown mainly in Southeast and East Asia, Northeastern India and Bhutan which has opaque grains, very low amylose content, and is especially sticky when cooked.

entries.label: glutinous rice flour
entries.definition: Flour made from glutinous rice.

entries.label: white wheat flour (unenriched, unbleached)
entries.definition: Flour that has not been bleached or enriched with nutrients during the manufacturing process.

entries.label: pastry flour
entries.definition: A flour is milled to a finer texture than all-purpose flour, and is made with soft wheat for a lower protein content than all-purpose flour.

entries.label: pet food (raw)
entries.definition: A pet food that has not been heat treated or otherwise preserved.

entries.label: pet treat
entries.definition: A food item intended to provide pleasure or reward to an animal, and which might not be nutritious.

entries.label: chicken thigh (debonned)
entries.definition: A chicken thigh that has been debonned.

entries.label: chicken thigh (skinless, debonned)
entries.definition: A chicken thigh that has been skinned and debonned.

entries.label: chicken carcass
entries.definition: A carcass of a chicken that includes all anatomical parts.

entries.label: chicken (butchered)
entries.definition: A chicken which has been defeathered, eviscerated, and cleaned

entries.label: chicken thigh (with skin, with bone)

aliases.norm: chicken thigh with skin with bone

entries.definition: A chicken thigh that contains skin and bone material.

entries.label: food (spoiled)
entries.definition: Food material unsuitable to ingest by a consumer due to spoilage related to the type of material it is, or to packaging or storage.

entries.label: food (adulterated)
entries.definition: Food material that has been grown, harvested, packed, or held under such conditions that it is unfit for food; or prepared, packed, or held under insanitary conditions whereby it may have become contaminated with filth, or whereby it may have been rendered injurious to health.

entries.label: harvested food material
entries.definition: Organism food material that has been harvested.

entries.label: sustainable agriculture food product
entries.definition: Food material produced by sustainable agricultural practices.

entries.label: cell-based technology food
entries.definition: A food product made from plant or animal cell lines incubated in a production facility.

entries.label: food harvested by hunting
entries.definition: Food material that is obtained by hunting, the practice of seeking, pursuing and capturing or killing wild animals.

entries.label: food harvested by gathering
entries.definition: Food material that is obtained by foraging the natural environment.

entries.label: food (not genetically-modified)
entries.definition: Food material which is produced from one or more organisms, none of which have changes in their DNA as a result of genetic engineering.

entries.label: food (fermented from innoculant)
entries.definition: A food product derived from a food fermentation process involving bacteria, yeast or mold culture.

entries.label: locally produced and consumed food
entries.definition: Food produced within a relatively short distance of where it is consumed (whether at a regional or smaller scale)

entries.label: wild harvested plant material
entries.definition: A plant or plant part that is obtained by foraging the natural environment.

entries.label: barley seed
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a barley plant (Hordeum vulgare subsp. vulgare).

entries.label: cumin seed
entries.definition: A seed of a cumin plant (Cuminum cyminum).

entries.label: ginkgo nut
entries.definition: A seed of a ginkgo plant (Ginkgo biloba)

entries.label: arabica coffee bean
entries.definition: A drupe fruit of the arabica coffee plant (Coffea arabica).

entries.label: pre-harvest food material
entries.definition: Organism food material which has not reached harvestable maturity.

entries.label: common bean
entries.definition: A seed of a common bean plant (Phaseolus vulgaris).

entries.label: common bean pod
entries.definition: A legume fruit of a common bean plant (Phaseolus vulgaris).

entries.label: broccoli floret
entries.definition: A raceme inflorescence of a broccoli plant(Brassica oleracea var. italica).

entries.label: cabbage head
entries.definition: A rosette of a cabbage plant (Brassica oleracea var. capitata).

entries.label: rapeseed
entries.definition: A seed of a rapseed plant (Brassica napus var. napus).

entries.label: carrot root
entries.definition: A primary root of a carrot plant (Daucus carota).

entries.label: cassava
entries.definition: A tuberous root tuber of a cassava plant (Manihot esculenta).

entries.label: cauliflower floret
entries.definition: A raceme inflorescence of a cauliflower plant (Brassica oleracea var. botrytis).

entries.label: celery stalk
entries.definition: A petiole of a celery plant (Apium graveolens Dulce Group).

entries.label: sugar beet
entries.definition: A primary root of a sugar beet plant (Beta vulgaris subsp. vulgaris).

entries.label: sweet cherry
entries.definition: A drupe fruit of a sweet cherry plant (Prunus avium).

entries.label: cowpea
entries.definition: A seed of a cowpea plant (Vigna unguiculata).

entries.label: cucumber
entries.definition: A pepo fruit of a cucumber plant (Cucumis sativus).

entries.label: durum wheat kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a durum wheat plant (Triticum turgidum subsp. durum).

entries.label: grape
entries.definition: A berry fruit of a grape plant.

entries.label: common hazelnut
entries.definition: A nut fruit of a common hazelnut tree (Corylus avellana)

entries.label: mustard seed
entries.definition: A seed of black mustard or indian mustard or white/yellow mustard plant.

entries.label: indian mustard seed
entries.definition: A seed of an indian mustard plant (Brassica juncea subsp. integrifolia).

entries.label: kohlrabi stem
entries.definition: A stem of a kohlrabi plant (Brassica oleracea var. gongylodes).

entries.label: lettuce leaf
entries.definition: A rosette leaf of a lettuce plant (Lactuca sativa).

entries.label: soft white wheat kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a soft white wheat plant.

entries.label: hominy grits
entries.definition: A type of grits made from hominy.

entries.label: maize kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a maize plant  (Zea mays subsp. mays).

entries.label: maize cob
entries.definition: An ear infructescence of a maize plant (Zea mays subsp. mays).

entries.label: oat
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of an oat plant (Avena sativa).

entries.label: perl millet kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a perl millet plant (Cenchrus americanus).

entries.label: radish
entries.definition: A root of a radish plant (Raphanus sativus).

entries.label: rhubarb stalk
entries.definition: A petiole of a rhubarb plant (Rheum rhabarbarum).

entries.label: raspberry
entries.definition: An aggregate fruit of a raspberry plant.

entries.label: whole grain rice kernel
entries.definition: A caryopsis fruit of a rice plant (Oryza sativa).

Excludes glazed, filled or frosted bakery products, which fall under *BAKERY PRODUCT, SWEETENED* and unsweetened filled products that fall under *PREPARED FOOD PRODUCT WITH BAKERY BASE OR ENCLOSURE, UNSWEETENED* or the appropriate narrower term.  See 21 CFR for description of some subgroups.

entries.definition: Pasteurized cheese product made with mandatory emulsifier and optional dairy ingredients. Milkfat minimum 20% of total; moisture minimum 44%, maximum 60% (21 CFR 133.179, 133.180).

entries.label: pasteurized process cheese (us cfr)
entries.definition: Pasteurized cheese product made with mandatory emulsifier and optional milkfat or cream. Milkfat minimum 47% of solids (43% for swiss, 45% for gruyere); moisture maximum 51% (21 CFR 133.169, 133.170, 133.171).

entries.label: pasteurized process cheese food (us cfr)

entries.definition: Pasteurized cheese product made with optional emulsifier and optional dairy ingredients. Milkfat minimum 23% of total; moisture maximum 44%.

entries.label: nonalcoholic beverage (us cfr)
entries.definition: Beverage containing no more than 0.5% alcohol; it may be flavored, sweetened or carbonated; includes soft drinks and steeped beverages; excludes milk in all forms, fruit juices, diluted fruit juices and vegetable juices.

entries.label: spice or herb (us cfr)
entries.definition: Aromatic or pungent plant product used whole or ground as a seasoning in food products.

entries.label: frozen dairy dessert (us cfr)
entries.definition: A frozen dessert prepared from one or more dairy ingredients or their analogs, plus other ingredients. Includes frozen dairy items offered in a cone, a sandwich or as a cake or pie, such as frozen yogurt in a cone or an ice cream sandwich; these are also indexed under *GRAIN ADDED*.

entries.label: cheese or cheese product (us cfr)

aliases.norm: cheese or cheese product us cfr

entries.definition: Natural cheese, cured or uncured, cheese product (which is further processed), or cheese product analog.

entries.label: cold-pack cheese product (us cfr)

aliases.norm: cold pack cheese product us cfr

entries.definition: Cheese product made without the aid of heat. See 21 CFR 133.123-125 for lists of cheeses that cannot be used.

entries.label: pasteurized cheese product (us cfr)
entries.definition: Food prepared by comminuting and mixing, with the aid of heat, one or more natural cheeses, with or without additional ingredients, into a homogeneous plastic mass; the product is packed while hot. See 21 CFR 133.167-180 for lists of cheeses that cannot be used.

entries.label: nutritive sweetener (us cfr)
entries.definition: A substance having greater than 2% of the caloric value of sucrose per equivalent unit of sweetening capacity. For example, the amount of such subtance having the sweetening capacity of 1 teaspoon of sucrose would have more than 0.4 calories (21 CFR 170.3(o)(21)).

entries.label: neutral distilled spirits (us cfr)
entries.definition: Distilled spirits produced at or above 190 proof and, if bottled, bottled at not less than 80 proof (27 CFR 5.22(a)).

entries.label: cream product analog (us cfr)
entries.definition: Food product having functional characteristics similar to a cream product; it may be nutritionally equivalent or inferior to the product it purports to resemble. Includes nondairy coffee whitener and nondairy topping.

entries.label: grain or starch product (us cfr)

aliases.norm: grain or starch product us cfr

entries.label: cold-pack cheese food (us cfr)

aliases.norm: cold pack cheese food us cfr

entries.definition: Cold-pack cheese product made with other dairy ingredients and without emulsifier. Milkfat minimum 23% of total; moisture maximum 44% (21 CFR 133.124, 133.125).

entries.label: fruit juice (us cfr)
entries.definition: The liquid extracted or expressed from mature fruit with or without the application of heat. Includes concentrated juice and single-strength juice. If the single-strength juice is prepared from concentrate, then *WATER ADDED* should be used. Carbonated fruit juices are indexed by *FRUIT JUICE* or *FRUIT JUICE, DILUTED* and *CARBONATED* or the appropriate narrower term.

entries.label: cheese product analog (us cfr)
entries.definition: Food product having functional characteristics similar to those of cheese or cheese product; it may be nutritionally equivalent or inferior to the product it purports to resemble. The ingredients may or may not be milk-based. An example is a cheese-like product made from skim milk and vegetable oil.

entries.label: fruit juice, diluted (us cfr)
entries.definition: Beverage prepared by diluting fruit juice to less than single strength, based upon accepted soluble solids values. Include beverages containing 15 to 99% fruit juice. *WATER ADDED* or the appropriate narrower term should be used to specify the degree of dilution.

entries.label: flavoring or seasoning (us cfr)
entries.definition: Product that imparts or helps to impart a taste or aroma in food (21 CFR.170.3(n)(26). [FDA CFSAN 1995]

entries.label: salt or salt substitute (us cfr)

entries.definition: Table salt and its substitutes; also products combining other flavors or seasonings with salt when these are predominantly salt.

entries.label: bakery product, sweetened (us cfr)
entries.definition: Includes cakes, cookies, pies, quick breads, doughnuts and related products, also bakery products that are glazed, frosted or have a sweetened filling. If sugar is not the first ingredient, *SUGAR OR SUGAR SYRUP ADDED* as well as *SWEETENER ADDED* (or the appropriate narrower term under each) should be indexed in *H. TREATMENT APPLIED*.

entries.label: soft cheese (us cfr)
entries.definition: The cheese is cured under conditions suitable for development of biological curing agents on the surface of the cheese, and the curing is conducted so that the cheese cures from the surface toward the center.

entries.label: pie crust, sweetened (us cfr)
entries.definition: Mixture of cookie crumbs or sweetened cracker crumbs and fat that is used as a base for fruit or other pie filling, e.g., graham cracker crust. Also includes ordinary pie crust that has been sweetened.

entries.label: aerated confectionery (us cfr)
entries.definition: Confectionery into which a substantial amount of air has been incorporated to produce a sponge-like or chewy texture. Examples are marshmallow and nougat.

entries.label: nonnutritive sweetener (us cfr)
entries.definition: Substance having less than 2% of the caloric value of sucrose per equivalent unit of sweetening capacity. For example, the amount of such substance having the sweetening capacity of 1 teaspoon of sucrose would have no more than 0.4 calories (21 CFR 170.3(o)(19)).

entries.label: fruit or fruit product (us cfr)

entries.definition: Fruit in all forms; includes fruit juices and fruit juice drinks, fruit butters, jellies, preserves, and related products.

entries.label: pasteurized blended cheese (us cfr)
entries.definition: Pasteurized cheese product made without emulsifier and with optional milkfat or cream. Milkfat minimum 47% of solids (43% for swiss, 45% for gruyere). Moisture maximum 51%. (21 CFR 133.167).

entries.label: seafood product analog (us cfr)
entries.definition: Food product having functional characteristics similar to a seafood product; it may be nutritionally equivalent or inferior to the product it purports to resemble.

entries.label: poultry product analog (us cfr)
entries.definition: Food product having functional characteristics similar to a poultry product; it may be nutritionally equivalent or inferior to the product it purports to resemble.

entries.label: cacao or chocolate product analog (us cfr)

aliases.text: cacao or chocolate product analog (us cfr)
aliases.norm: cacao or chocolate product analog us cfr

entries.definition: Food product having functional characteristics, primarily taste, similar to those of a *CACAO OR CHOCOLATE PRODUCT*. Carob or artificial chocolate flavor may replace chocolate or cocoa in the product.
